answer.likely_change: In crates/background/src/runner.rs, gate the three automatic paths on the rule's configured triggers: the HostStart check at line 100, the TaskEnded check at lines 107 and 112-116, and the Interval check at lines 118-121. Only schedule the interval timer (lines 101 and 119) when rule.interval() is Some; otherwise wait only on the task poll. Leave the Request::Run / manual() path ungated so openagents background run and /background still work.
acceptance: Removing HostStart from the rule's triggers means no check runs at host start.
Removing TaskEnded from the rule's triggers means ending a task does not trigger a check.
Removing Interval from the rule's triggers means no interval checks are scheduled, with no 300 s fallback.
An enabled rule with an empty trigger list performs no automatic cleanup, even when disk is low.
Manual runs (openagents background run and /background) still run the rule regardless of triggers.
